//: Named action spaces. DISCRETE spaces are arrays of actions; each action holds `held` key codes for the frame, optionally fires `press` as a p5 keyPressed() event (a press key is ALSO down for that frame, in every runtime), and may carry analog fields: `pointer` [x,y] in [0,1]^2 (canvas-relative; LATCHED — persists until another action moves it), `buttons` (['mouse']; ABSOLUTE per step — released unless the action holds them; a 0->1 edge fires mousePressed()), and `axes` (up to 4 floats in [-1,1]; ABSOLUTE per step — snap back to center unless the action sets them). BOX spaces are {type:'box', channels:[...]} where a channel is 'pointer_x' | 'pointer_y' | 'axis:0'..'axis:3' | 'button:mouse' | 'key:<code>'; the env exposes Box(-1,1,(k,)) (pointer channels use [0,1]) and every channel is absolute each step. ALL analog values are quantized to uint16 at the producer — q = floor(clamp(v01)*65535 + 0.5), dequantized v01 = q/65535 identically in every engine — so replay and the cross-engine gate stay bit-exact. Key codes are p5/browser keycodes: LEFT_ARROW 37, UP_ARROW 38, RIGHT_ARROW 39, DOWN_ARROW 40, SPACE 32. Indices 0-7 of default8 are frozen: every recorded trajectory, human-study session, and the native/gate_qjs.sh golden traces depend on this exact mapping.
